# GraphQL Automatic Persisted Queries (APQ) & Security

Hardening production GraphQL: Automatic Persisted Queries (APQ), SHA-256 query whitelisting, disabling introspection in production, and depth limits.

## Invariants
- DISABLE_INTROSPECTION_IN_PRODUCTION
- ENFORCE_AUTOMATIC_PERSISTED_QUERIES
- MAX_QUERY_DEPTH_RESTRICTION
